name: cs-navigator
description: Route capability-selection questions using version-bound trust evidence and bundle a small set of chat-native CS skills.

interface.longDescription: CS Navigator 0.7.0 routes capability-selection questions using current evidence, freshness, permission footprint, security findings, execution fit, and known gaps. It keeps ordinary direct tasks with ChatGPT and bundles Language Bridge, Impact Map, Resilience Plan, and Adaptive Experiment in one install.
defaultPrompt: Tell me whether this task needs a skill or ChatGPT can handle it directly.
Find the smallest useful current CS capability for this goal.
Check whether this skill has current evidence or needs re-review.
